title: Captain Enoch
subtitle: Galactic Empire
description: As Grand Admiral Thrawn's mysterious captain of the guard, Captain Enoch boasted a custom Stormtrooper helmet with a gold face mask hammered into it. An ominous and capable sentinel, Enoch did Thrawn's bidding during their exile to Peridea in a far off galaxy after being banished there by the purrgil and the actions of Ezra Bridger in the early days of the Galactic Civil War.
